news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.39 (vs ₹2.90 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.39 (down from ₹2.90 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹142.0m (down 70% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹15.4m (down 47% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 11% (up from 6.1% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 86% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 34% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: MRP Agro Limited Approves the Appointment of Akanksha Aswani as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer Designated as Key Managerial Personnel of the Company, Effective January 01, 2025
news.body: MRP Agro Limited approved the appointment of Ms. Akanksha Aswani (ACS-41662) a qualified company secretary as company secretary and Compliance Officer designated as Key Managerial Personnel of the company, effective January 01, 2025 as per the recommendation of Nomination and Remuneration Committee.  Ms. Akanksha Aswani (ACS-41662) has been appointed as the Whole Time Company Secretary & Compliance Officer of the Company. Ms. Akanksha Aswani is an Associate Member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (Membership No. ACS- 41662) and has 07-year experience in dealing with matters of Companies Act, Listing Regulations and allied laws.
